module_summary: 8-to-16-bit width converter: a toggle flag tracks byte parity, the first byte is held in a buffer, and the second byte completes a registered 16-bit output with valid.

anchors.name: flag
anchors.why: Toggles per valid byte; selects buffering first byte versus emitting concatenated word.

anchors.name: data_lock
anchors.why: Holds first byte, becomes upper half of data_out.

anchors.name: data_out
anchors.why: Registered 16-bit word of buffered byte and current data_in.

anchors.name: valid_out
anchors.why: One-cycle pulse when second byte arrives and data_out updates.

anchors.name: valid_in
anchors.why: Input byte valid; toggles flag and gates buffer and output loads.

anchors.name: data_in
anchors.why: 8-bit input byte, buffered or used as lower output half.

groups.name: byte_tracker
groups.description: Flag toggling on each valid byte to pair bytes.

groups.name: packer
groups.description: Buffers first byte and concatenates with second into 16-bit output.
